snippet.title: Campsite Hustle! - Official Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Campsite Hustle! will be released on 2 June 2026 for PC.
Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3708070/Campsite_Hustle__Management_Simulator/

Build your own Outdoor Store and Camping Business in the heart of Red Shore Valley! Arrange your shelves, manage your stock, construct facilities on your campsite, and take care of every guest. Grow from humble beginnings into a thriving business surrounded by nature! 

Developer: Red Shore Games
